s2:BCD Spectrophotometry and Rotation of Active B-Type Stars: Theory and Observatio

rationale: The paper 2506.02662 provides evidence that the rapid rotation of Be stars, and thus the formation of their gaseous disk envelopes, may originate from binary evolution, specifically through binary mass transfer processes. This contributes substantive new evidence to the question of the origin of the gaseous disk envelope surrounding Be stars.
